result.instructions: Tools for TapGoods, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which rentals start this weekend, and what is still unpaid?"; "Show the rental with token ABC123, its customer and its totals."; "How many of product 42 are in stock at our main location?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes TapGoods data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run tapgoods_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run tapgoods_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run tapgoods_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. tapgoods_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: tapgoods_list_rentals
tools.title: List rentals
tools.description: List rentals (quotes, reservations, and orders) for the business, with customers, status, dates and totals. Filter by status, location, customer, name or date range. Read only. GraphQL: getRentals.

locationIds.description: Limit to these location ids. Omit for all locations.

statuses.description: Rental statuses to include, for example as TapGoods reports them.

startDate.description: Only rentals with a start date on or after this date-time.

endDate.description: Only rentals with an end date on or before this date-time.

isDraft.description: true for drafts only, false for non-drafts.

tools.name: tapgoods_get_rental
tools.title: Get a rental
tools.description: Get one rental by its id or token, with customers, location, products and totals. Read only. GraphQL: getRentalById.

rental.description: The rental id or token (from tapgoods_list_rentals).

tools.name: tapgoods_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List rental products for the business or for given locations, with prices and quantities. Filter by search text or ids. Read only. GraphQL: getProducts.

search.description: Text filter on the product name.

locationIds.description: Limit to these location ids. Omit for all locations.

tools.name: tapgoods_list_inventory
tools.title: List inventory
tools.description: List inventory items at one location, with the quantity held for each product, bundle, accessory or add-on. Read only. GraphQL: getInventories.

locationId.description: The location id to read inventory from.

search.description: Text filter on the item name.

updatedAfter.description: Only items updated on or after this date-time.

updatedBefore.description: Only items updated on or before this date-time.

tools.name: tapgoods_get_location
tools.title: Get a location
tools.description: Get one location's details: name, status, contact email, locale and location code. Read only. GraphQL: getLocationDetails.

tools.name: tapgoods_list_pick_list_statuses
tools.title: List pick list statuses
tools.description: List the pick list statuses of one location, for checking items out and in. Read only. GraphQL: getPickListStatuses.

name.description: Return only the status with this exact name.

tools.name: tapgoods_find_locations_with_availability
tools.title: Find locations with available inventory
tools.description: Find locations within a radius of a point that have enough inventory for the items and dates given. Read only. GraphQL: getLocationsWithAvailableInventory.

reventalsInventoryId.description: The Reventals inventory id of the item.

inventory.description: Items needed, with the quantity of each.

startDate.description: Start of the rental period, ISO 8601 date-time.

endDate.description: End of the rental period, ISO 8601 date-time.
